name: Schaller
notes: Schaller has unusually strong primary-period documentation available through surviving 1970s catalogs, manuals and price lists. ToneHome dates the Fuzz-Sustain to 1972, while Bandecho preserves multiple Schaller catalogues and effect documentation. This is a strong independent German manufacturer node deserving later Queue B catalog enumeration.

name: Blackfield Orchester-Elektronik
notes: TONEHOME documents the large Flying Sound fuzz/wah/phaser as built in Germany by Blackfield Orchester-Elektronik, probably around 1971. Effects Database separately records a Blackfield Fuzz as an OEM version of the Schaller Fuzz. Preserve Blackfield as its own historical manufacturer/brand node while keeping the Schaller OEM relationship separate.

name: Kay / Uecks
dirt_evidence: Kay Fuzz Tone / Uecks Fuzz Tone
notes: Recent historical research establishes the Kay Fuzz Tone as Japanese-made and places its print-market appearance from late 1973 through roughly 1978, but the physical manufacturer remains unresolved. The same pedal was sold in Japan as the Uecks Fuzz Tone, associated with Ueki Gakki. Preserve this as a candidate lineage node rather than assigning the factory to Ueki, Teisco, Maxon or another builder without stronger evidence.

name: Martian Sound
dirt_evidence: Cydonia Germanium Harmonic Multiplier / booster with harmonic distortion
notes: New brand from Zak Martin, creator of Spaceman Effects. Preserve Martian Sound as its own current builder entity while linking Zak Martin to the earlier Spaceman lineage; do not merge the two companies.

name: Sunhaus
dirt_evidence: Loei synthetic fuzz; Kong Ra fuzz; Rama heavy distortion; Jubilee
notes: First release documented as Loei in March 2021, followed by Kong Ra and Rama later in 2021; mid-2025 production resumed with refined earlier models and new releases. Full builder chronology and geography require later confirmation.

name: O.C.E. Pedals
dirt_evidence: Wrench Fuzz; Wrench Fuzz V2; They Don't Compare distortion; other Hardware Series dirt
notes: Founder Chris states the first Wrench evolved from an early-2021 Hardware Fuzz run and that a V2 was created after transistor sourcing problems. Company closure was announced in January 2026. Preserve V1/V2 as builder-level catalog states rather than treating them as unrelated builders.

name: Colortone Pedals
dirt_evidence: Parasite Overdrive; additional current and historical pedal products
notes: Sydney builder. Current site states products are individually designed, handcrafted and assembled in Sydney. Parasite has a documented 2024 retool for a pedalboard-friendlier enclosure while retaining the same circuit/tone, followed by a 2026 May revision.

name: Colombo Audio Electronics
dirt_evidence: The One; Over Drive; JMP Experience; Eruption; Plexi Breed; Rocker 83; 22 Overdrive/Distortion; Bricks; Muff Blaster; Pop Festival; Utopia Overdrive and other dirt products
notes: Italian builder with a broad 37-plus-product pedal catalog and explicit handmade production in Italy. The public catalog spans overdrive, distortion and fuzz; complete model enumeration should be performed before pedal-depth work.

name: Pecked Audio
dirt_evidence: Distortion/overdrive first release; analog octaver fuzz; later effects
notes: Founder Matteo reported in 2022 that Pecked Audio was based in Rome, began making original effects in 2021 and had released three pedals, including a distortion/overdrive and an analog octaver fuzz. Treat forum self-report as documentary builder evidence; seek primary product archive later.

name: Monochrome
notes: Builder Marco reported in 2025 that Monochrome operates from a small one-person workshop in the Ligurian Alps and that Fuzz One was the first release. Preserve as a current micro-builder candidate pending independent primary-site chronology.

name: O.C.E. Pedals / Wrench lineage
dirt_evidence: Hardware Fuzz -> Wrench Fuzz -> Wrench Fuzz V2
notes: Not a second builder. This row exists solely to force reconciliation between the builder identity and the product-generation trail during canonicalization.

name: Colortone Pedals / Colortone
dirt_evidence: Parasite Overdrive and broader Colortone pedal catalog
notes: Do not create a second builder named Colortone. Use Colortone Pedals as the canonical builder and retain Colortone as a naming alias where needed.
